response.justification: Bogdan has exceptional technical depth, open-source contributions, and diverse experience across architectures and languages, but lacks demonstrated leadership in IT consulting, formal project management, and UML expertise — and his German is only basic, falling short of the required C1 proficiency.
strengths: Strong open-source leadership with GISCollective and multiple public tools
Proven full-stack expertise across Linux, Node.js, DLang, and cloud infra
Demonstrated mentoring and workshop experience in testing and web internals
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting C1 requirement
No clear evidence of architectural design leadership or UML modeling in client projects
Lacks explicit experience in IT consulting, risk/compliance, or client advisory roles
